messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — EvolvInc QBR prep for next Wed. They called out an unexpected spike in embedding costs after the last activation. Need a concise spend forecast, token run-rate breakdown, and any immediate mitigations we can propose. Who can own the cost slide?
Jordan: I can own the deck section. Will pull 30d + 90d trailing usage and model mix. Can someone confirm whether they're on Hosted or Dedicated?
Sophie: They're on Hosted (region us-west). Onboarding status: integration ~70% done, search embeddings ramped last Tue. I logged feedback: "embedding latency inconsistent at higher concurrency".
Ravi: Got it. I can run a per-route spend forecast but need per-model token rates and recent per-minute concurrency. Jordan — can you share the model IDs you see in telemetry?
Jordan: Will share in a sec. From a quick glance: mostly open-embedding-v2 and a tiny fraction of redwood-1-3b for rerank.
Sam: For mitigations: suggest enabling prefix caching + set batching to 16 for embedding route. Also can provide a quantized model suggestion (int8) for non-critical recalc jobs. Example config to propose:
```
route: /embed/search
batching: { enabled: true, max_batch_size: 16 }
caching: { prefix_kv: true, ttl_secs: 3600 }
model_profile: open-embedding-v2-quant-int8 (perf test required)
```
Sophie: @Sam that config looks good. The customer asked specifically about preserving quality vs cost — can you add a short note on expected embedding drift risk with int8?
Sam: Sure — short note: "int8 may increase small drift for edge semantic cases; recommend A/B on 5k prompt set before rollout."
cost-bot: Alert: EvolvInc daily tokens = 1.2M (90th pct), embeddings account for 78% of token spend. (auto-scan 2024-11-02)
Maya: Okay action items: Jordan — cost slide + model mix + raw telemetry by Fri EOD. Ravi — forecast (30/90/365) with sensitivity to 20% ramp and 50% throttle options. Sam — short mitigation write-up + config + expected perf hit by Fri EOD. Sophie — capture two customer quotes about latency and include current onboarding completion % in the deck. I'll consolidate and send a draft to the renewal rep.
Jordan: +1. I'll drop the raw CSV in the shared drive and ping the thread.
Ravi: Will include a simple table for renewal discussion: baseline vs throttled vs opt-config cost. Example row: 
`baseline: $18k/mo, throttle-50%: $10.5k/mo, quant-int8: $12.2k/mo`
Sophie: I'll loop in Solutions Engineering for a short live demo to show batching/caching benefits during the QBR.
Maya: Thanks team. If we can get the draft by Mon morning that gives Product a day for review. Tag me when it's in drive. :thumbsup:
Sam: tagging QA to prioritize a 1-hr eval on the 5k prompt set tomorrow.
cost-bot: Note: Billing alert threshold set at 1.5M/day for EvolvInc. Current trend projects hitting threshold in ~9 days if ramp continues.
Maya: Noted — we'll propose an interim guardrail (soft throttle policy) as part of the recommendations.
Jordan: Uploaded telemetry CSV to /drive/EvolvInc/qbr/telemetry.csv — pinged in drive.
Maya: Closing loop: owner list documented. I'll draft the deck outline and post by Mon. Thanks all.
